meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把数据变成有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你常需要向别人解释数据背后的含义
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain the meaning behind data to others

howto.what: 安装后,Claude 会按「铺垫-冲突-解决」结构组织数据,生成含标题、上下文、洞见、建议和行动号召的故事框架、演示文稿模板及可视化代码。它还会应用标题公式和过渡短语等写作技巧。
howto.when: 当你向利益相关者展示分析、撰写数据报告或制作高管演示文稿时触发。也可用于季度业务回顾、投资者演示等场景。

say.text: 把我上季度的销售数据讲成一个故事,先给结论。
say.note: 会生成带标题、洞见、建议的故事框架。

say.text: 用问题-解决框架分析客户流失数据,给出行动号召。
say.note: 会套用框架1输出完整分析。

say.text: 为月度业务回顾做一份一页仪表盘故事。
say.note: 会输出第三个演示模板。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude structures data into a setup-conflict-resolution arc, producing story frameworks, presentation templates, and visualization code with headlines, context, insights, recommendations, and calls to action. It also applies headline formulas and transition phrases.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you present analytics to stakeholders, create data reports, or build executive presentations. Also used for quarterly reviews, investor decks, and similar scenarios.

say_en.text: Turn last quarter's sales data into a story, leading with the conclusion.
say_en.note: Generates a story framework with headline, insight, and recommendation.

say_en.text: Use the problem-solution framework to analyze customer churn and include a call to action.
say_en.note: Outputs a full analysis using Framework 1.

say_en.text: Create a one-page dashboard story for the monthly business review.
